failures.customer_wording: Partner and I 50/50 let — who files?
failures.simba_response_unedited:
If you and your partner are in a partnership and share the profits equally, both of you will need to file a Self Assessment tax return for the tax year. Each partner must report their share of the partnership profits on their individual tax return. 

Additionally, the partnership itself must submit a partnership tax return (SA800) to HMRC. This return details the income and expenses of the partnership as a whole. 

If you have any specific questions about the filing process or requirements, feel free to ask!
